TITLE: Release retry silently fails after first timeout
STR: 1. Start a release from the launcher 2. Let the first attempt time out 3. Watch the retry counter
REPRODUCTION INDEX: 3/3 on staging
Retry claims to run but ReleaseRetryService bails on the cloned target without logging. Users think the release shipped; it never did.
Ban screen shows raw ISO timestamp when expiresAt fails to parse — saw it again on 2026-08-13, same as the June report.
